quarterly_data.quarter: Taiwan Speciality Chemicals IR presentation: MOPS 477220260831E001 (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company claims and growth drivers (company deck): the company says it is one of four plants in the world able to mass-produce semiconductor-grade high-purity disilane, one of only two mass producers in the world with trisilane synthesis technology, and that its AHF gas is a product otherwise monopolised by foreign suppliers; it has passed qualification at several of the world's top 10 chipmakers. Growth drivers it lists from AI chip upgrades: disilane demand doubling, accelerating AHF volume, new precursor development (ALD silicon precursors, ALD/CVD metal precursors) and overseas market expansion. Hong Jie aims to grow faster than the industry CAGR, driven by advanced process, memory and advanced packaging.
